about: Providers an external-embed@1 activity may open (docs/activities-dev/embed.md). A URL must match one provider exactly: https only, its origin one of origins, its path / query / hash fully matching the patterns (a regex subset that JS and Python read alike; anchored at both ends). status 'pending': known, refused until its embedding terms are confirmed. The runtime (src/runtimes/external-embed/check.ts) imports this file as it is.

providers.name: PhET
providers.creditMust: PhET Interactive Simulations, University of Colorado Boulder
providers.credit: PhET Interactive Simulations, University of Colorado Boulder · {title} · {license} · https://phet.colorado.edu
providers.notes: HTML sims published before 2026-03-29: CC BY 4.0 (commercial use allowed; the credit, the licence and https://phet.colorado.edu as close to the point of use as possible; translating the credit is allowed). PhET's 2025 impact report announces a shift to CC BY-NC for newer sims, and its FAQ says commercial use needs a licence: read the sim's publication date in its About dialog and pick the licence. Every HTML sim page offers an Embed code. No result channel: PhET-iO (the instrumented API) is licensed separately. Language: ?locale=.

providers.name: GeoGebra
providers.notes: GeoGebra licence: the apps and the materials are free for non-commercial use with attribution (materials CC BY-NC-SA); commercial use (e.g. inside a non-academic e-book or a paid product) needs a licence from GeoGebra. Share > Embed gives the material/iframe URL. Explore only: the ggbApplet API needs deployggb.js running in OUR page (a third-party script in the app's origin: refused) or same-origin access to the frame; the iframe embed has no documented postMessage channel.

providers.name: Desmos
providers.notes: A saved graph's Share > Embed gives https://www.desmos.com/calculator/<id>?embed (no API key; Desmos staff on the API forum: the iframe route needs no API). The JS API (calculator.js) needs an API key and runs in OUR page: refused. The Terms of Service restrict commercial use. Explore only.

providers.name: Falstad Circuit Simulator
providers.notes: Code: CircuitJS1, GPLv2. Site terms: use in a classroom unmodified; non-commercial modification or redistribution with credit and a link; 'for any other uses, contact me'. Framing the hosted page on another site is not addressed: PENDING until Paul Falstad confirms, or self-host the GPL build later (same origin: then its CircuitJS1 JS API could give a result channel). Cross-origin, that API is out of reach.

providers.name: CircuitJS1 (Lush Projects)
providers.credit: CircuitJS1 by Paul Falstad and Iain Sharp (lushprojects.com/circuitjs) · {license}
providers.notes: Iain Sharp's hosted CircuitJS1 (GPLv2; the README says to embed the full-page version in an iframe, written for self-hosted copies). No terms for framing the hosted service: PENDING. Same API situation as falstad.

providers.name: Wokwi
providers.notes: Arduino / ESP32 / Pi Pico simulator, free to use. No public documentation of iframe embedding or of its terms was found (2026-11): only an 'early prototype, subject to change' partner embed (/_alpha/wembed/) in wokwi-embed-bridge-example. PENDING until Wokwi documents or confirms embedding. A project compiles the learner's code on Wokwi's servers.
